description:
A drone in the fleet, registered as 'SH-CRASH-001', has been destroyed in an accident. You need to process the warranty replacement in the Aerobridge system.

1. Locate the aircraft 'SH-CRASH-001'.
2. Decommission it by appending ' [WRITE-OFF]' to its Registration name (so it becomes 'SH-CRASH-001 [WRITE-OFF]') and setting its status to 'Inactive' (or unchecking Active) if that option is available.
3. Register the replacement unit as a new Aircraft with Registration 'SH-REPL-002'.

CRITICAL: The replacement aircraft MUST be assigned to the SAME Operator and SAME Manufacturer as the crashed unit. You must look up these details from the old record before creating the new one.
